The files are used in as synthetic send data, derived from https://github.com/VICT3Rproject/VCG-RPackage/tree/main/inst/extdata/cdisc-org-SEND-examples

The .csv files are used to generate sample SEND data (send.ts) to using test/fixtures/generate.mjs.
Hereafter, send.ts is used to test math.ts and different plots.
